load_humanoid_urdf: load a humanoid URDF model into PyBullet with self-collision and fixed base constraints
load_motion_capture_json: load a JSON motion capture file containing frame-by-frame humanoid joint rotation and base position data
compute_pd_torques_stable: compute PD control torques using PDControllerStableMultiDof for a humanoid with desired joint positions and velocities
compute_pd_torques_explicit: compute PD control torques using PDControllerExplicitMultiDof for a humanoid with desired joint positions and velocities
control_joints_multidof: control humanoid multi-DoF joints using POSITION_CONTROL, STABLE_PD_CONTROL, or TORQUE_CONTROL via setJointMotorControlMultiDof
